title: Live With Their Parents
subtitle: 與父母同住；和父母居住在一起
description: 與父母同住；和父母居住在一起

words.meaning: 與父母同住；和父母居住在一起
words.note: 較正式，適合報告、研究、人口統計或書面語。reside with 強調居住狀態，本身不表示這是暫時還是永久安排。
words.example: Many young adults continue to reside with their parents after graduation.
words.exampleZh: 許多年輕人在畢業後仍與父母同住。

exercises.original: The survey found that 42% of respondents still live with their parents after leaving university.
exercises.zh: 調查發現，42% 的受訪者離開大學後仍與父母同住。
exercises.upgrade: reside with their parents · 與父母同住；和父母居住在一起

options.explanation: reside with their parents = 與父母同住。survey + percentage + still 是正式人口／居住情況語境，reside 很自然。
stay over with their parents = 在父母家過夜。通常表示短暫留宿，不代表主要住所。
visit their parents = 探望父母。探望不等於共同居住。
live independently = 獨立居住。和原意相反。
board with strangers = 寄宿在陌生人家。居住對象不同。
move between homes = 在多個住所之間移動。原句沒有這種安排。

exercises.original: According to the census, a growing number of adults live with their parents into their thirties.
exercises.zh: 根據人口普查，愈來愈多成年人到三十多歲仍與父母同住。
exercises.upgrade: reside with their parents · 與父母同住；和父母居住在一起

options.explanation: stay in the family home = 留在家庭住所。意思接近，但 census 這種正式統計語境，reside with their parents 更精準。
reside with their parents = 與父母同住。正式、客觀，適合人口普查語境。
stay temporarily = 暫住。into their thirties 顯示是持續居住，不是短期。
share with roommates = 與室友合住。居住對象不同。
visit home often = 經常回家探望。並不表示主要住所。
return for holidays = 假期回家。只是季節性探親。

exercises.original: The report distinguishes between students who live with their parents and those who rent accommodation elsewhere.
exercises.zh: 報告區分與父母同住的學生和在其他地方租住的學生。
exercises.upgrade: reside with their parents · 與父母同住；和父母居住在一起

options.explanation: reside with their parents = 與父母同住。和 rent accommodation elsewhere 形成正式、清楚的居住狀況對比。
visit their parents = 探望父母。不是居住安排。
stay overnight occasionally = 偶爾留宿。頻率不足以表示同住。
live on campus only = 只住校。和與父母同住相反。
share a flat with friends = 與朋友合租。居住對象不同。
commute from another city = 從另一城市通勤。原句沒有這種資訊。

words.meaning: 留在家庭住所；繼續住在家中
words.note: 強調成年子女繼續住在原本的家庭住所，而沒有搬出去。語氣自然，常見於談年輕人延遲離家、經濟因素或家庭安排。
words.example: Some graduates stay in the family home while saving for a deposit.
words.exampleZh: 有些畢業生在儲首期期間繼續住在家中。

exercises.original: After graduation, Maya decided to live with her parents while saving enough money to rent her own apartment.
exercises.zh: 畢業後，Maya 決定在儲夠錢租自己的公寓前繼續住在家中。
exercises.upgrade: stay in the family home · 留在家庭住所；繼續住在家中

options.explanation: stay in the family home = 留在家庭住所。while saving to rent her own apartment 表示她暫時沒有搬出去。
reside abroad = 居住海外。地點完全不同。
live independently = 獨立居住。和原句相反。
move in with friends = 搬去和朋友住。不是和父母同住。
stay in a hotel = 住酒店。不是家庭住所。
house-sit elsewhere = 到別處代人看屋。居住安排不同。

exercises.original: Rising rents mean that many young workers continue to live with their parents instead of moving out.
exercises.zh: 租金上升意味着很多年輕上班族繼續住在家中，而沒有搬出去。
exercises.upgrade: stay in the family home · 留在家庭住所；繼續住在家中

options.explanation: rent independently = 獨立租屋。和 instead of moving out 相反。
stay in the family home = 繼續住在家中。rising rents + instead of moving out 是決定性線索。
visit home weekly = 每週回家探望。不是主要住所。
return for dinner = 回家吃飯。與居住無關。
share with colleagues = 和同事合住。對象不同。
live in company housing = 住公司宿舍。地點不同。

exercises.original: He chose to live with his parents for another year so he could finish paying off his student debt.
exercises.zh: 他選擇再住在家中一年，以便還清學生貸款。
exercises.upgrade: stay in the family home · 留在家庭住所；繼續住在家中

options.explanation: stay in the family home = 留在家庭住所。for another year + paying off debt 清楚表示延後搬離家庭住所。
live on his own = 獨自居住。相反。
move overseas = 搬到海外。無關。
stay with friends = 住朋友家。不是父母家。
commute from a dormitory = 從宿舍通勤。不是家庭住所。
rent a studio = 租套房。和原句相反。

words.note: 最自然、最口語的表達之一。對成年人而言，live at home 通常表示仍住在父母的家，但語境需要讓『home』指家庭住所。
words.example: He still lives at home while completing his degree.
words.exampleZh: 他在完成學位期間仍住在家裡。

exercises.original: She still lives with her parents while studying at a university nearby.
exercises.zh: 她在附近大學讀書期間仍住在家裡。
exercises.upgrade: lives at home · 住在家裡；和家人同住

options.explanation: lives at home = 住在家裡。university nearby + still 表示她沒有搬出去，是很自然的口語說法。
boards at school = 寄宿學校。和住父母家不同。
lives alone = 獨居。相反。
stays with classmates = 住同學家。對象不同。
lives overseas = 居住海外。無關。
travels from a hotel = 從酒店往返。不是家庭住所。

exercises.original: Do you still live with your parents, or have you moved into your own place?
exercises.zh: 你仍住在家裡，還是已搬到自己的住所？
exercises.upgrade: live at home · 住在家裡；和家人同住

options.explanation: reside formally with your parents = 正式與父母同住。意思可通，但日常問句中太書面。
live at home = 住在家裡。和 moved into your own place 是最自然的口語對比。
visit home = 回家探望。不是主要住所。
sleep over at home = 在家過夜。語意奇怪，也不表示長期居住。
return home often = 經常回家。不能等同同住。
share a room = 共用房間。沒有說和誰，也不等於住父母家。

exercises.original: Because her office is close to her parents' house, she lives with them and commutes from there.
exercises.zh: 因為她的辦公室離父母家很近，她住在家裡並從那裡通勤。
exercises.upgrade: lives at home · 住在家裡；和家人同住

options.explanation: lives at home = 住在家裡。parents' house + commutes from there 清楚界定 home 指父母家。
lives in residence = 住宿舍。不是父母家。
stays in hotels = 住酒店。無關。
shares with coworkers = 與同事合住。對象不同。
lives alone = 獨居。相反。
commutes from campus = 從校園通勤。地點不同。

words.meaning: 繼續住在家中；仍留在家庭住所
words.note: 比 live at home 稍正式，強調某人『仍然』住在家中，尤其適合描述延遲搬出、暫時維持原有居住安排。
words.example: Some adults remain at home until they are financially ready to move out.
words.exampleZh: 有些成年人會繼續住在家中，直到經濟上準備好搬出去。

exercises.original: Many graduates live with their parents until they are financially able to move out.
exercises.zh: 很多畢業生會繼續住在家中，直到經濟上有能力搬出去。
exercises.upgrade: remain at home · 繼續住在家中；仍留在家庭住所

options.explanation: remain at home = 繼續住在家中。until they are financially able to move out 明確表示維持原有居住安排。
move out early = 提早搬出。相反。
live independently = 獨立生活。相反。
stay abroad = 留在海外。無關。
share with friends = 和朋友合住。不同。
rent immediately = 立即租屋。和 until financially able 相反。

exercises.original: He plans to live with his parents for a few more months before moving into student accommodation.
exercises.zh: 他打算再住在家中幾個月，然後搬進學生宿舍。
exercises.upgrade: remain at home · 繼續住在家中；仍留在家庭住所

options.explanation: stay away from home = 不住在家。相反。
remain at home = 繼續住在家中。for a few more months + before moving 是明確的延續狀態。
move in with roommates now = 現在搬去和室友住。時間不符。
live on campus immediately = 立即住校。相反。
travel home weekly = 每週回家。不是同住。
visit his parents = 探望父母。不是居住。

exercises.original: She decided to live with her parents until her new apartment was ready.
exercises.zh: 她決定在新公寓準備好之前繼續住在家中。
exercises.upgrade: remain at home · 繼續住在家中；仍留在家庭住所

options.explanation: remain at home = 繼續住在家中。until her new apartment was ready 表示暫時維持現有住所。
live independently = 獨立居住。相反。
stay in a hotel = 住酒店。不是父母家。
move overseas = 搬海外。無關。
house-share elsewhere = 在其他地方合租。相反。
visit home occasionally = 偶爾回家。不是居住。

words.word: Share A Home With Their Parents
words.meaning: 與父母共住一個家；和父母共享住所
words.note: 較中性，強調父母和成年子女共用同一住所。比 live with their parents 稍有『共同居住安排』的意味。
words.example: Several adult children share a home with their parents to reduce living costs.
words.exampleZh: 一些成年子女為減低生活成本而與父母共住一個家。

exercises.original: The couple live with his parents and split household expenses with them.
exercises.zh: 這對夫婦和男方父母同住，並共同分擔家庭開支。
exercises.upgrade: share a home with his parents · 與父母共住一個家；和父母共享住所
exercises.answer: share a home with his parents

options.text: share a home with his parents
options.explanation: share a home with his parents = 與父母共住一個家。split household expenses 顯示是共同維持同一住所。
visit his parents = 探望父母。沒有共同居住意味。
rent separately = 分開租屋。相反。
stay in a guesthouse = 住賓館。無關。
live overseas = 住海外。無關。
board with strangers = 和陌生人寄宿。對象不同。

exercises.original: To reduce costs, three generations now live together in the same house.
exercises.zh: 為了減低開支，三代人現在住在同一所房子裡。
exercises.upgrade: share a home · 與父母共住一個家；和父母共享住所

options.explanation: remain apart = 分開居住。和 same house 相反。
share a home = 共住一個家。three generations + same house 是最自然的共同居住表達。
live independently = 獨立居住。相反。
visit one another = 互相探訪。不是同住。
stay temporarily elsewhere = 暫住別處。相反。
rent separate units = 分租不同單位。題目說同一所房子共同居住。

exercises.original: They live with her parents, and everyone contributes to the mortgage and utility bills.
exercises.zh: 他們和她的父母同住，而且每個人都會分擔按揭和水電費。
exercises.upgrade: share a home with her parents · 與父母共住一個家；和父母共享住所
exercises.answer: share a home with her parents

options.text: share a home with her parents
options.explanation: share a home with her parents = 和父母共住。everyone contributes to mortgage and bills 表示共同家庭安排。
visit her parents regularly = 定期探望。沒有共同承擔住屋成本。
stay as guests = 以客人身份暫住。共同付按揭不符合客人語境。
rent next door = 租隔壁。不是同一住所。
live on their own = 自己住。相反。
commute from elsewhere = 從其他地方通勤。無關。

words.meaning: 與父母共同居住（正式／研究用語）
words.note: 非常正式，常見於社會學、人口研究、住屋研究和統計寫作。co-reside 強調兩代或多代人在同一住所共同居住。
words.example: The study examines why some young adults co-reside with their parents.
words.exampleZh: 這項研究探討部分年輕成年人為何與父母共同居住。

exercises.original: The researchers examined why some unmarried adults live with their parents after age 30.
exercises.zh: 研究人員探討部分未婚成年人為何在三十歲後仍與父母共同居住。
exercises.upgrade: co-reside with their parents · 與父母共同居住（正式／研究用語）

options.explanation: co-reside with their parents = 與父母共同居住。researchers + demographic group 是典型學術住屋研究用語。
stay over with their parents = 在父母家過夜。太短暫。
visit their parents = 探望父母。不是同住。
live separately = 分開住。相反。
rent with peers = 與同輩合租。不是父母。
travel home = 回家。不是居住狀態。

exercises.original: The paper compares adults who live with their parents with adults who maintain separate households.
exercises.zh: 論文比較與父母共同居住的成年人和維持獨立家庭的成年人。
exercises.upgrade: co-reside with their parents · 與父母共同居住（正式／研究用語）

options.explanation: stay in the family home = 留在家庭住所。意思接近，但 academic paper + separate households 更適合 co-reside。
co-reside with their parents = 與父母共同居住。是人口與住屋研究中的正式用語。
visit their parents = 探望父母。不是共同家庭。
share a room only = 只共用房間。範圍太窄。
live nearby = 住在附近。不是同一住所。
return home often = 經常回家。不是同住。

exercises.original: The survey tracks the percentage of young adults who live with their parents across different income groups.
exercises.zh: 調查追蹤不同收入群體中與父母共同居住的年輕成年人比例。
exercises.upgrade: co-reside with their parents · 與父母共同居住（正式／研究用語）

options.explanation: co-reside with their parents = 與父母共同居住。survey + percentage + income groups 是非常典型的研究語境。
stay overnight at home = 在家過夜。不能表示主要居住安排。
visit home = 回家探望。不是同住。
live alone = 獨居。相反。
share with friends = 和朋友合住。對象不同。
move frequently = 經常搬家。原句沒有這個意思。

words.meaning: 住在父母家；暫時和父母住
words.note: 當 live with their parents 是暫時安排，例如搬家過渡期、假期、找房期間或短期需要，可用 stay with their parents。stay 通常比 live 更有暫時性。
words.example: She is staying with her parents until her new lease begins.
words.exampleZh: 她會暫時住在父母家，直到新租約開始。

exercises.original: While his apartment is being renovated, he is living with his parents for six weeks.
exercises.zh: 他的公寓翻新期間，他會和父母暫住六星期。
exercises.upgrade: staying with his parents · 住在父母家；暫時和父母住

options.explanation: staying with his parents = 暫住父母家。for six weeks + apartment being renovated 明確是短期安排。
residing permanently with his parents = 永久與父母同住。和六星期相反。
living independently = 獨立居住。相反。
boarding elsewhere = 在別處寄宿。地點不同。
renting nearby = 在附近租屋。不是父母家。
visiting on weekends = 週末探訪。不是六週連續居住。

exercises.original: She will live with her parents until she finds a new apartment.
exercises.zh: 她會暫住父母家，直到找到新的公寓。
exercises.upgrade: stay with her parents · 住在父母家；暫時和父母住

options.explanation: remain permanently at home = 永久住家。until she finds a new apartment 顯示不是永久。
stay with her parents = 暫住父母家。until she finds... 是典型過渡安排。
live alone = 獨居。相反。
move abroad = 搬到海外。無關。
share with coworkers = 和同事合住。對象不同。
visit her parents = 探望父母。不是居住。

exercises.original: During the gap between leases, they lived with his parents for two months.
exercises.zh: 兩份租約之間的空檔期，他們在男方父母家暫住兩個月。
exercises.upgrade: stayed with his parents · 住在父母家；暫時和父母住

options.explanation: stayed with his parents = 暫住父母家。gap between leases + for two months 明確是短期過渡。
co-resided permanently = 永久共同居住。和兩個月不符。
lived independently = 獨立居住。相反。
rented another flat = 另租公寓。原句沒有。
visited occasionally = 偶爾探望。不是連續住兩個月。
moved overseas = 搬海外。無關。

words.meaning: 居住在父母的住所；住在父母家
words.note: 較正式、客觀，常見於社會研究、住屋分析和政策討論。parental home 強調住所屬於父母／家庭，而非單純口語的 home。
words.example: Housing costs influence how long young adults live in the parental home.
words.exampleZh: 住屋成本會影響年輕成年人在父母家居住多久。

exercises.original: High housing costs have increased the number of young adults who live with their parents.
exercises.zh: 高住屋成本令住在父母家的年輕成年人數目增加。
exercises.upgrade: live in the parental home · 居住在父母的住所；住在父母家

options.explanation: live in the parental home = 居住在父母住所。high housing costs + young adults 是典型政策／住屋研究語境。
stay at hotels = 住酒店。無關。
rent alone = 獨自租屋。相反。
live on campus = 住校。不是父母家。
share with friends = 和朋友合住。對象不同。
move overseas = 搬海外。無關。

exercises.original: The study asks how long adults continue to live with their parents before forming independent households.
exercises.zh: 研究詢問成年人在建立獨立家庭前會在父母家住多久。
exercises.upgrade: live in the parental home · 居住在父母的住所；住在父母家

options.explanation: stay temporarily with relatives = 暫住親戚家。對象與時間含義都不同。
live in the parental home = 居住在父母住所。study + before forming independent households 是正式住屋研究語境。
visit their parents = 探望父母。不是主要住所。
live nearby = 住在附近。不是同住。
rent separately = 分開租屋。和 forming independent households 前的狀態相反。
board at work = 在工作場所寄宿。無關。

exercises.original: Researchers found that people remained living with their parents longer in cities with expensive rents.
exercises.zh: 研究人員發現，在租金昂貴的城市，人們住在父母家的時間更長。
exercises.upgrade: lived in the parental home · 居住在父母的住所；住在父母家

options.explanation: lived in the parental home = 住在父母家。researchers + expensive rents + longer 是正式分析居住安排的典型語境。
visited home = 回家探望。不是居住。
lived alone = 獨居。相反。
shared with colleagues = 和同事合住。不是父母家。
rented rooms elsewhere = 在其他地方租房。相反。
stayed on campus = 住校。地點不同。

falseSynonyms.zh: 探望父母不等於一般的 live with their parents visit their parents = 探望父母 visit their parents 只表示去探訪父母，不代表主要住所和父母相同。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON You can visit your parents without living with them.

falseSynonyms.zh: 留宿；過夜不等於一般的 live with their parents stay over = 留宿；過夜 stay over 通常是短暫過夜，可能只有一晚或幾晚，不能直接等同長期與父母同住。
